purpose: Check whether a supplied expected company name matches the authoritative SEC EDGAR company identity resolved from exactly one ticker or CIK.

decision_policy.match: SEC resolves the ticker/CIK and the canonical supplied company name exactly matches the canonical SEC company name after common corporate suffix normalization.
decision_policy.human_review: SEC resolves the company but the supplied expected company name does not exactly match the canonical SEC company name.
decision_policy.company_not_found: The SEC lookup completed but the ticker/CIK did not resolve to a company.

claim_boundaries: match is only an SEC identity-consistency result
it does not establish investment quality, current good standing, ownership, authority, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
company_not_found means the queried identifier did not resolve in the checked SEC public data; it is not proof that the business does not exist
